digest.component_or_area: graph loader/BFS centralization and ticket unblock detection
propositions: The target-side guard `_is_at_level` in `_same_level_neighbors` must refuse direct cross-level deps when the far end is the queried source_id, else false cycles are detected across incompatible hierarchy levels.
Lower-level hops cannot reconnect two same-level nodes in cycle detection; an epic→task→epic chain must return False even though the end-to-end walk would otherwise traverse three nodes.

When a blocker dir is unreducible and reduce returns None with a tombstone present, a status-only stub must be created from the tombstone payload, making non-terminal recorded statuses observable to unblock logic.

A present tombstone's status field must override the reduced status when determining if a blocker is closed, so a tombstone with `status: deleted` marks a blocker as closed regardless of the dir's recorded state.
A malformed (unparseable) tombstone must degrade to `deleted` rather than to absent, so unblock detection treats an unparseable tombstone as evidence the blocker is closed.
